import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced with escaped user input. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def create_blog_post(heading: str, text: str) -> str: """ Prepare a blog post for safe HTML display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. text : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized, HTML-formatted string ready for rendering on the web page. Notes ----- * The function escapes all special HTML characters in both the heading and the body to prevent injection attacks (CWE‑74). The escaping is performed with ``html.escape`` which converts characters such as &, <, >, ", and ' into their corresponding HTML entities. * The body text is also split into paragraphs by double newlines to preserve formatting while still escaping content. Each paragraph is wrapped in a ``

`` tag. """ # Escape the heading and body content safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) # Preserve line breaks by converting paragraphs paragraphs = [html.escape(p.strip(), quote=True) for p in text.splitlines() if p.strip()] safe_body = "\n".join(f"

{para}

" for para in paragraphs) # Format the final HTML return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_body)
